faqs.q: Why do directory sites outrank local electricians in Vancouver?
faqs.a: Large directories carry enormous authority, so they often sit above a single business for broad terms. The strategy is to win the specific, high-intent searches that describe your work and your part of Vancouver.

faqs.q: How competitive is electrician SEO in Vancouver?
faqs.a: It depends on the job you focus on. Broad terms in Vancouver are contested, often by directories and larger operators, but searches tied to Coal Harbour, Mount Pleasant or a specific job are far easier for a local electrician to win.

faqs.q: Should I try to target all of Vancouver at once?
faqs.a: Usually not. A profile set to the entire city dilutes relevance. It is more effective to serve your real catchment first, then extend into neighbouring areas with pages of their own.

faqs.q: Is Vancouver too competitive to bother with SEO?
faqs.a: Not if you are specific. Vancouver is large enough that most of its searches are narrow, and those narrow searches are the ones a focused electrician can realistically own.
